_about: Hands-on milestones placed in the learning plan after each core skill or at least every 4 weeks (pathway.md §4.5). Tasks are synthetic practice suggestions written by the team; case_id links to a Qart practice case where one exists. Hours are team estimates.

milestones.title: Review an AI-prepared bank reconciliation in Qart
Find a double-counted payment in a practice case
Decide whether an AI-flagged timing item is really a problem, in a practice case
Recompute one foreign-currency receipt at the documented rate and note the difference
Challenge an unsupported adjustment in a practice case
Pull one month of transactions with SQL and chart them in a small dashboard
Clean a messy export with a short Python script and note what you changed
Automate one repetitive step of a monthly task and write down the control that checks it
Build a simple forecast for one cost line and explain the main variance
Use an AI assistant on a real work task and list what you had to correct
Write a one-page brief for a process change after interviewing two colleagues
Turn a month-end report into a one-page summary for a manager

default.title: Apply what you learned to one task at work or in a personal project, and write three lines on what changed
